title: Overdraft Facility - sanction at Bank's discretion
text: Sanction of Overdraft limit will be at the sole discretion of the Bank and subject to pre-checks/internal policies/guidelines of the Bank and the Bank shall not be liable for any reason thereof.

title: Overdraft Facility - Fixed Deposit as security
text: In consideration of the Bank agreeing to grant me a Temporary Overdraft facility for an amount not exceeding the predefined limit which will not exceed 90% of the amount/s that may be held by the Bank in Fixed Deposits on my behalf, I hereby agree, record and confirm, that the Bank shall have a first charge on the amount/s of such Fixed Deposits (which expression shall mean and include all such amounts standing to my credit in the Fixed Deposit account with the Bank and whether such sums are additional to or by way of renewal of or replacement for any sums deposited/to be deposited by me with the Bank or otherwise together in each case with all and any interest accruing in respect thereof) as a continuing security for the due repayment by me to the Bank on demand of all the sums which at any time or from time to time become due and owing by me to the Bank in respect of the said Temporary Overdraft Facility and all interests, costs, charges, expenses, and other amounts whatsoever which may become due and payable by me to the Bank.

title: Overdraft Facility - Bank authorization to appropriate and adjust FD amounts
text: I hereby irrevocably and unconditionally authorise the Bank to appropriate, adjust and set off the amount/s of such Fixed Deposits towards the dues of the Bank in the event of my failure to pay the amount demanded from me by the Bank, the demand of the Bank being conclusive as to my liability for repayment thereof and for the said purpose. I hereby irrevocably and unconditionally authorise the Bank to, basis my consent terminate all or any part of the Fixed Deposit prior to the maturity date thereof.

title: Overdraft Facility - interest calculation and payment terms
text: I shall pay to the Bank interest at such rate or rates as may be determined by the Bank, upon the daily debit balances outstanding in the Account, which interest shall be calculated and shall be due and payable by monthly rests and compounded, if not paid when due.

title: Overdraft Facility - authorization to debit interest from linked account
text: I/we authorize the bank to debit the applicable interest on the utilised overdraft amount from my linked Bank account as and when the interest is due to be paid by me/us to the Bank.

title: Overdraft Facility - overdue interest on excess or prevented liquidation
text: If the Account is in excess of the prescribed Overdraft Limit or for any reason the Bank is prevented from liquidating the Fixed Deposits or any part thereof, I recognize and agree that the Bank shall be entitled to charge interest at rates over and above/in addition to the applicable rate of interest by way of overdue interest (unarranged overdraft - 18% p.a) or such other name as may be given by the Bank and I agree that such higher/additional rates shall be in the nature of damages and not penalty.

title: Overdraft Facility - termination with notice
text: I hereby irrevocably and unconditionally agree that the Bank shall be entitled to discontinue or terminate the said Temporary Overdraft Facility at any time with 30 days notice to me.

title: Overdraft Facility - rate unchanged on FD premature liquidation
text: In case of premature liquidation of the fixed deposit against which the overdraft has been taken, the rate applicable on the overdraft utilized will remain unchanged.

title: Supersaver Facility - Average Monthly Balance maintenance on withdrawal
text: I am aware that incase a Supersaver facility is withdrawn by me, then I have to maintain the stipulated Average Monthly Balance for that entire month and also in subsequent months.

title: Overdraft Facility - overdraft limit unchanged on FD autorenewal
text: I am aware that the Bank will provide a Temporary Overdraft facility of predefined amount. On autorenewal of my Fixed Deposit along with the Principal, the overdraft limit remains unchanged. In case I require a higher limit, I will be required to provide written instructions to the Bank.

title: Overdraft Facility - authorization to break/encash/liquidate FD before maturity
text: I/we hereby expressly authorize the Bank to break/encash/liquidate any or all of the Fixed Deposits even before the maturity date of such Fixed Deposits and adjust the amount thereof (including interest thereon) against the amount outstanding under the Overdraft Facility and/or in the Account and hereby agree and undertake not to hold the Bank responsible for any loss arising thereof including loss of interest on premature encashment.

title: Overdraft Facility - authorization to renew FD with interest
text: I/we hereby expressly authorize the Bank in case the Temporary Overdraft facility is subsisting to renew without any further act, deed or thing from me/us any or all of the Fixed Deposits with interest thereon as per the rates then applicable for such periods as may be decided by the Bank, at its absolute discretion.

title: Overdraft Facility - NRI deposit overdraft purpose declaration
text: I hereby declare that the overdraft/loan sanctioned against my NRI deposit above is for the purpose of meeting my personal/business expenditure. I further declare that the overdraft/loan amount will not be utilized for relending, Investment in Real Estate Business, Agriculture and plantation activities. I/We agree the Overdraft/loan amount shall not be remitted outside India or credited to any NRE/FCNR(B)/NRNR account.

title: Overdraft Facility - NRE/FCNR deposits no premature withdrawal
text: In reference to the Overdraft against NRE/FCNR deposits availed against my/our deposit(s): As per RBI circular A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 44 dated October 12, 2012 premature withdrawal of NRE/FCNR deposits shall not be available where loans against such deposits are to be availed of. I/We hereby agree to abide by the above regulation. I/We hereby declare that I/We shall not seek premature withdrawal of the said Deposit(s) till the Overdraft facility is repaid by me/us. The above is without prejudice to the bank's right to prematurely close the Deposit(s) in case of default in payment of principal or interest or failure to adhere to any of the other terms and conditions as per your Overdraft application.

title: Overdraft Facility - Metro & Urban savings account minimum FD requirement
text: For savings account held singly by Metro & Urban branch customers, minimum FD amount of Rs. 25,000 for a minimum period of above 6 months is required to avail OD against FD.

title: Overdraft Facility - Semi Urban & Rural savings account minimum FD requirement
text: For savings account held singly by Semi Urban & Rural branch customers, minimum deposit amount of Rs. 5,000 for a minimum period of above 6 months is required to avail OD against FD.

title: Overdraft Facility - Current Customers minimum FD requirement
text: For Current Customers, minimum deposit amount of Rs. 25,000 for a minimum period of above 6 months is required to avail OD against FD.

title: Overdraft Facility - OD limit percentage
text: Upto 90% of FD principal amount granted as Overdraft (OD).

title: Overdraft Facility - OD interest rate
text: OD rate only 2% p.a over FD rate, for the number of days the limit is utilized.

title: Overdraft Facility - interest charged only on utilized amount
text: Interest will be charged only on the amount utilized.

title: Overdraft Facility - Debit Card usage on clear balance only
text: Debit Card usage on accounts with Overdraft (OD) against Fixed Deposit is permitted only against the clear balance available in the account.

title: Overdraft Facility - OD limit not usable for ATM/POS/online transactions
text: The OD limit cannot be used for ATM, POS, or online debit card transactions.
